evals.prompt: Use $skill-creator. Design a new skill named ‘release-notes’ that turns a verified git diff into concise release notes. Return the proposed SKILL.md frontmatter/body outline, explain what belongs in references instead of the main file, and define two eval cases with measurable expectations. Do not create files.
evals.expected_output: A valid skill design with compliant frontmatter, focused instructions, progressive disclosure, and concrete eval cases using measurable expectations.
expectations: The response includes compliant lowercase hyphenated name and a useful trigger description in frontmatter.
The response keeps the main skill focused and moves detailed material to references or optional resources.
The response defines at least two concrete eval cases.
The eval design uses measurable expectations rather than vague quality claims.
